resources.string: Share your phone screen to a projector or Android TV on the same Wi-Fi.
Open PhoneCast on the projector, then plug this phone into the projector’s USB port. The projector will switch the phone into PhoneCast USB mode.
The USB link is busy. Unplug the cable and plug it back in.
The projector is not connected by USB. Replug the cable and wait for “Projector connected by USB”.
Searching your Wi-Fi… Open PhoneCast on the projector first.
…or type the address shown on the projector
Enter the address shown on the projector
Sound sharing needs Android 10 or newer
Some apps (Netflix, Prime Video, banking apps…) block screen capture and will show black. Apps can also refuse to share their sound.
Use THIS device as the receiver
The previous session was still closing — please tap the projector again.
This device does not support screen capture.
Could not connect to %1$s (%2$s). Check both devices are on the same Wi-Fi and the receiver is open.
Connection to the receiver was lost.
Sound could not be captured — video only.
On your phone, open PhoneCast and tap this device — or type this address:
Waiting for a phone to connect…
No network — connect this device to Wi-Fi.
🔌 Or plug the phone into this projector’s USB port for the lowest lag.
USB mode needs Android 8+ and a USB host port on this device.
Phone detected on USB — accept the prompt on the phone.
Phone connected by USB — tap “Share to projector over USB” on the phone.
Both devices must be on the same Wi-Fi (or the projector joined to the phone hotspot). Press Back to exit.
